## Pose onto a cleaned photo, then ground the cutout

1. Ask Gemini to remove the person and keep the background. Load that in EMPTY BACKGROUND and the original in REFERENCE PHOTO.
2. SCENE FROM REFERENCE describes that photo's place and lighting. BUILD PROMPT puts that after the character line. SCENE PROMPT shows the text that is actually used.
3. NEW CHARACTER is generated in the reference pose, then stitched onto the empty background.
4. COPY REFERENCE FACE pastes only the reference face, and only where it sits inside the new character.
5. MARRY PASS redraws only the contact ring (CONTACT MASK): feet on the ground, contact shadow, and a soft edge. KEEP CHARACTER, KEEP FACE puts that ring back and leaves the face and the body interior untouched.

If the person still floats, raise the first number on CONTACT HALO. If the face or clothes change, lower the denoise on MARRY PASS.

nodes.title: SCENE FROM REFERENCE
widgets_values: Look at this photograph and write one detailed image-prompt paragraph about only the setting: the place, background, surfaces, weather, lighting, light direction, time of day, color of the light, camera angle, and depth of field. Match what is actually visible. Do not mention the person, their face, hair, body, clothes, or pose.
